name: ranged_sustained_fire
about: An NPC's clip never runs down: it fires an eighth shot from a six-round weapon. The ranged_open_fire staging (a hostile TutorialThug gunman with item_w_thirtyeight, Size 6, fighting from the open at ~387 units), run long enough for eight shots. Retail fills an NPC's clip once, at equip (Inventory_Insert 0x10334e70: max(Default_Size, 1)), and CWeaponRanged's Shot 0x102387b0 subtracts Ammo_Cost only inside its player block (0x10238a15): an NPC wielder's clip never drops, so NO_PRIMARY_AMMO (0x40) cannot rise from firing and no REAL reload arises from clip spend; after six sets an NPC fake-reloads (0x102b8620 / 0x102c54c0 / 0x10268919) (stories/v4/packets-S4.md item a; stories/v1/triage.md, Judge's rulings, V4 -- second sitting, J12). Each shot is the attack clip's 3031 event (smith_attack authors 3031 at cycle 0, male move_and_ranged) through CWeaponRanged's operator 0x10238160. Eight animevent 3031 on the shooter, never cond+ NO_PRIMARY_AMMO, never TASK_RELOAD.
notes: ShotFromAnimEvent -> CommitQueuedAttack (0x10238160 -> 0x102387b0) commits NPC event bullets; ordinary Shot spends only for players (0x10238a15). MakePlayerUnkillable at 0.05 keeps the target alive. Seed 1: shot six 16.500, 0xc4 19.500, no-cover 0xc5 19.600, Pistol_Reload_Fast finishes 22.100, taskdone and shot seven 22.200. The measured 5.700 s gap includes the last wait and fake reload; shot_7 uses 6.0 s. Other 8.0 s shot windows retain the range-scaled wait evidence. BEHIND_ENEMY stays forbidden (slot 363 V5a/A3). V6 epoch1 measurement: sixth shot12.150, wait ends16.550, c5 reload begins16.650. The seed-specific6s last-shot gap mixed the preceding attack wait with reload. Keep the6s continuation bound anchored to the actual reload clip; the preceding8s attack-wait bound stays explicit (0x102b8620/0x102c54c0).
